answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks with staked identity graphs. Each verified agent controls one identity vertex and locks a bond; influence comes only from attestations by neighbors with real trades, so fake accounts with no honest inbound edges carry zero weight. To gain weight the attacker must bribe attestors, and since voting power scales with the square of stake while cost is linear, doubling influence costs four times the bond. Any unearned delta between claim and behavior slashes the stake, so clones in a lagoon of self-attesting accounts lose everything.
